svg.text: Arduino Uno + soil moisture sensor + micro servo · dry soil → the servo turns to let water flow · pins from the owner's Tinkercad design
Servo — turns to let the water flow
push the two prongs into the soil
Build it in this order — numbers match the white circles on the wires

Pins read from the Tinkercad screenshot of "Super Fulffy": sensor → A0, servo → D9 (medium confidence: the printed 9 is under the wire), power from the Uno 5 V / GND. Sensor and servo pin labels are not legible there;
their roles follow the wires (+ rail, − rail, A0 / D9). Tinkercad uses only the bottom rails; here power goes through the top rails so no wire crosses another — electrically the same.

Example sketch plant-watering.ino (2026; the original Tinkercad code was not kept): print the A0 value in dry and wet soil, then set DRY_BELOW. A micro servo runs from the Uno 5 V; a pump would need its own supply.
